reason_execution_not_authorized: Eight-client native LODO driver and independent metric replay not yet code-verified; no target predictions allowed

data.local_archives: 9/9 local SHA matches; 25/25 original CSV/RAR member bytes match direct UCI public download
data.correction: 9 benign original raw-byte CSV SHA sidecar supersedes invalid previous Stage13 header-digest metadata; original SQLite fields not mutated
data.test_policy: All original native rows of each heldout device, no target downsampling/deduplication; original class distribution intact

folds.inv: Target device never used in training, preprocessing, model selection, class weighting, thresholds or early stopping

modeling.task: binary benign vs attack (source path labels)
modeling.transform: asinh then per-feature train-eight-sources-only mean and SD (zero SD ->1)
modeling.sample_rng: numpy.random.default_rng(seed + canonical_device_index*111), choose 30000 lowest random priority values
modeling.source_sample_bank: Cache per-device-per-seed subsamples and for each fold load only eight source device shards, never target shard
modeling.class_weight: per source client negative/positive counts from sampled source rows only
modeling.checkpoint_selection: Last predefined round, not best target result

analyses.primary_endpoint: Equal-device-weighted nine-device mean binary balanced accuracy
analyses.primary_method_contrast: FedProx minus FedAvg device-level paired BA, after within-device seed aggregation
secondary: attack-class recurring/unseen recall within eligible device/class cells
analyses.exact_feature_groups: 115-vector source device union vs heldout equality as ANALYSIS-ONLY variable
analyses.unit_of_uncertainty: nine target devices, not individual rows or three seeds
analyses.after_test_exploratory: Any new analyses or tests post target inspection must be disclosed as exploratory

evidence_before_freeze.source_tester: Samsung prior pilot used for optimizer feasibility, so this is post-exploratory, not nine historical lockboxes

stop_gate: Do not open/score any outer target for model evaluation before fixed eight-client engine and row-level independent metric replay have been audited, and code+environment SHA recorded.
